name: Handysize Bulk Carrier 40,000 DWT

deadweight_t.provenance: scenario label from STEP 1; not used directly in the fuel equation

service_power_kw.provenance: model assumption for STEP 2; not an identified vessel MCR

co2_emission_factor_t_per_t_fuel.provenance: provisional model assumption; verify against the cited CF table before reporting

fuel_model.interpretation: estimated tank-to-wake CO2 for a toy model

limitations: The parameters do not identify a real vessel.
Power and SFOC are held constant in the minimum STEP 2 model.
Weather-to-speed or weather-to-power corrections are not enabled until documented and tested.
Results must be labelled as model estimates and not operational fuel or emissions figures.
